csv_project_name: PD for 145th N Snake RV Bridge Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The Local Highway Technical Assistance Council (LHTAC) and Bonneville County are seeking qualified and experienced respondents from interested firms to submit a proposal for planning services for the 145th N Snake River Bridge Replacement project in Bonneville County. This consultant will put together a team to analyze and recommend a replacement alternative for the 145th N Snake River Bridge. The scope of this planning grant will include public involvement, alternatives analysis, environmental scan, and conclude with a concept report or TS&L as funds allow. Design process to follow the ITD Bridge Manual and ITD design guide. The completion date for the grant is September 2027.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
